name: cube-nft-blockchain
description: ARZONE CUBE NFT contracts and independent Blockchain Server

scripts.build: npm run build --workspace=contracts/cube-nft && npm run build --workspace=server
scripts.test: npm run test --workspace=contracts/cube-nft && npm run test --workspace=server
scripts.lint: npm run lint --workspace=contracts/cube-nft && npm run lint --workspace=server
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --workspace=contracts/cube-nft && npm run typecheck --workspace=server
scripts.smoke:build: npm run build:server && node -e "require('node:fs').accessSync('server/dist/main.js'); console.log('OK server/dist/main.js')"
scripts.smoke:docker: docker build -f server/Dockerfile -t cube-nft-blockchain-server:smoke . && docker run --rm --name cube-nft-smoke -d -p 3377:3000 --env-file .env -e PORT=3000 -e DATABASE_URL=${SMOKE_DATABASE_URL:-mysql://cube_nft:cube_nft@host.docker.internal:3306/cube_nft} -e TRANSACTION_RPC_URL_PRIMARY=${SMOKE_RPC_URL:-http://host.docker.internal:8545} -e CUBE_NFT_NETWORK=${SMOKE_NETWORK:-localhost} cube-nft-blockchain-server:smoke && sleep 12 && curl -fsS http://127.0.0.1:3377/health && curl -fsS http://127.0.0.1:3377/ready; STATUS=$?; docker rm -f cube-nft-smoke >/dev/null; exit $STATUS
